title: Renaissance Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description This Fabergé egg was designed in the likeness of a 17th-century casket by Le Roy, a master craftsman from Amsterdam. The original work, made of agate and decorated with enamel, diamonds, and rubies, was the quintessence of the Neo-Renaissance style. This unique coin precisely reproduces its rich details: from the intricate lattice, through floral motifs, to the distinctive gold lion heads. It is a celebration of classic beauty and perfection, captured in a numismatic form.
